findings.heading: Load packages and import data / Chargement des paquets et importation des données
findings.proposition: The English has exactly one level-2 heading for this section ('Load packages and import data'); the French emits two consecutive level-2 headings for it, an untranslated copy of the English heading at line 29 and the French heading at line 32, with no content under the first.
findings.reader_consequence: The French reader gets a stray empty section in the rendered page and in the table of contents, one of which is still in English, so the chapter appears to have a section that was never written and the numbering of subsequent sections shifts by one.

findings.heading: Import data / Importer les données
findings.proposition: The English links the phrase 'Download book and data' to the page data_used.qmd; the French renders it as the bare bracketed text '[Donwload book and data]' with no link target.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader who wants the linelist_cleaned.xlsx dataset to follow the chapter step by step sees literal square brackets instead of a link and has no way to reach the download instructions from this page.

findings.heading: Import data / Importer les données
findings.proposition: The English links the phrase 'Import and export' to the page importing.qmd; the French renders it as the bare bracketed text '[Import and export]' with no link target.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader who needs the other ways of importing data cannot navigate to the Import and export chapter from this sentence, and sees unresolved bracket syntax in the rendered text.

findings.heading: The i argument: selecting and filtering rows / L'argument i: sélection et filtrage des lignes
findings.proposition: The English says the second and third examples 'subset' cases (perform row selection); the French says they 'sous-entend' (imply/hint at) that the cases are 18 years or over, which describes an inference rather than the subsetting operation the code performs.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader is told the expression implies something about the cases rather than that it filters rows, so the purpose of `linelist[age >= 18]` in the chunk that follows is stated incorrectly, and the term is inconsistent with 'sous-ensemble' used correctly a few lines later at line 94.
